referenceSources.description:
The 2000 Dodge Viper GTS-R Oreca, car number 51, is presented in its striking red and white Le Mans livery. Prominent sponsor decals such as Mopar Performance Parts, Mobil 1, Michelin, and Bosch decorate the body, while a “24 Heures du Mans 2000” sticker and French flag graphic highlight its endurance racing heritage.

This gallery image from PlanetCarsZ captures the Viper’s aerodynamic profile, featuring a large rear wing, racing wheels, and Chrysler branding. The photograph emphasizes the car’s track-focused modifications and historic participation in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
